title: Columbia top 80 — primary-topic vote audit
description: One row per distinct T1 author and work in the 2021–2024 snapshot on which that author lists Columbia or an included child institution, all work types. Shows work ID, primary topic ID, explicit field/subfield labels, joined taxonomy labels and stable IDs, eligibility outcome and the resulting vote IDs. No vote for missing or invalid primary topics; no secondary topic fallback.
